info.title: Mail Verifier
info.summary: Check whether email addresses can actually receive mail.
info.description: Verifies addresses by talking to the receiving mail server over SMTP, without sending a message. Send up to ten addresses per request and get a `valid` or `invalid` verdict for each.

post.description:
SMTP verification involves a live conversation with each recipient's mail server, so a request with ten addresses can take tens of seconds. Set your client timeout accordingly.

Some providers accept every address at the SMTP stage (catch-all domains); those come back `valid` even when the mailbox does not exist.

key.description: Your API key, repeated as a form field. Kept for existing integrations; the `Authorization: Bearer` header is the supported way to authenticate.

emails.description: One or more addresses separated by commas. At most ten per request.

200.description: A verdict per address and the time the check took.

status.description: `"200"` on success (a string). See status codes below.

message.description: Explanation when the request could not be processed, otherwise `null`.

x-status-codes.title: OK
x-status-codes.description: Processed. If `mails` is absent, `message` explains why (no addresses sent, or more than ten).

x-status-codes.title: Key expired
x-status-codes.description: The key's validity period has ended. Contact support to renew it.
